info.title: School Diary API
info.description: School-scoped academic records with session authentication, CSRF protection, enrollment history and audited grades. See README for role policies.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Session login and CSRF token lifecycle. Fetch a new CSRF token after login.

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: One-time registration invitations for students and teachers

tags.name: Attendance
tags.description: Lesson rosters, attendance and finalized reports

200.description: Append-only grade history, available after deletion

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt may be made

get.summary: List invitations visible to the current administrator
get.description: School administrators see their school. Global administrators see invitations for all schools.

post.summary: Invite a student or teacher to a school
post.description: The token is returned once and expires after 24 hours. Share the link privately with the intended recipient.

post.summary: Revoke a pending invitation within the administrator scope
Create an account from a valid invitation
post.description: The invitation determines the email, school and role. Obtain CSRF state before submitting. A successful activation is followed by normal login.

get.summary: List attendance lessons for a subject
get.description: Available to the assigned teacher and in-scope administrators.

post.description: Uses the server date in the academic year and snapshots current active enrollments. The lesson number distinguishes lessons on the same day.

get.summary: Read a lesson and its attendance roster
get.description: Available to the assigned teacher and in-scope administrators. Includes status corrections.

put.summary: Save the full roster against its current version
put.description: Send every captured student once. Drafts allow unmarked students. Finalized lessons require every status and can only be corrected as FINALIZED.

get.summary: Read own finalized attendance for a period
get.description: Student only. Counts cover the full period and rows are paginated. Late counts toward attendance percentage.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First included lesson date. The period may cover up to 366 dates.

get.summary: Read a scoped school attendance report
get.description: Administrator only. Filters apply to finalized student-lesson records. Class uses the captured lesson class.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First included lesson date. The period may cover up to 366 dates.

parameters.name: schoolId
parameters.description: Global administrators may select a school. School administrators are scoped to their school.

post.summary: Enroll an enabled student by exact email
post.description: Uses the assigned subject and school scope. The student must already have an enabled account in that school.

Conflict.description: Request conflicts with existing data, for example a duplicate email or a resource still in use.

Forbidden.description: Access denied or missing/invalid CSRF token

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
csrfToken.description: Swagger UI fetches the token automatically. Other clients must retain the session cookie and send the token from GET /api/auth/csrf in this header. Fetch a fresh token after login.
